alone.line: Who loved me right down to my bones
stanza: The tree by my window
Turns gray in November
I watch the leaves as they fall
The branches left naked
Reach up so proudly
I wish to Cod you would call
But me I'm the dead one
You are the lover
Who loved me right down to my bones
Now I walk through the fire alone

partner.line: Now I walk through the fire alone

alone.songTitle: (Sittin’ On) The Dock of the Bay
stanza: Sittin' here resting my bones
And this loneliness won't leave me alone
It's two thousand miles I roamed
Just to make this dock my home

partner.line: And this loneliness won't leave me alone

home.line: And he dug up her grave and built a cage with her bones
stanza: After ten long years, they let him out of the home
"Excitable boy," they all said (Ooh-ooh, excitable boy)
And he dug up her grave and built a cage with her bones
"Excitable boy," they all said (Ooh-ooh, excitable boy)
Well, he's just an excitable boy

partner.line: After ten long years, they let him out of the home

home.line: Thoughts of you they warm my bones
stanza: Thoughts of you they warm my bones
I'm on the way, I'm nearly home
Let's get lost, me and you
An ocean and a rock is nothing to me

partner.line: I'm on the way, I'm nearly home

home.line: She's in my skin and bones
stanza: She's in my skin and bones
She's grace and glory
She's a backroads home
She's a long story
Yeah, the one goodbye that I can't even imagine
She's a well thought out plan and I don't know how it happened
She's in my skin and bones
She's in my skin and bones

home.line: The drones turned her beautiful boy into a pile of bones
home.lineNext: No body to bury, nobody is home

partner.line: No body to bury, nobody is home

home.line: But you would still miss me in your bones
stanza: And I can go anywhere I want
Anywhere I want, just not home
And you can aim for my heart, go for blood
But you would still miss me in your bones
And I still talk to you (When I'm screaming at the sky)
And when you can't sleep at night (You hear my stolen lullabies)

partner.line: Anywhere I want, just not home

home.line: Trying to rid you from my bones
stanza: And I am a writer, writer of fictions
I am the heart that you call home
And I've written pages upon pages
Trying to rid you from my bones
My bones
My bones

partner.line: I am the heart that you call home

home.line: The eyes of temptation, the flesh on my bones
stanza: Old toys, this plastic heart
Lovers and fools are tearin' me apart
Here comes trouble, the uninvited, this brutal love
Danger, not quite at home
The eyes of temptation, the flesh on my bones
Hello stranger, I'm a disaster, this brutal love

home.line: By the third knock, a chill ran through my bones
home.linePrev: Your car was in the driveway, I knew you were home
home.lineNext: The way you missed Mama, I guess I should've known
